title: Trump is right: EV range anxiety is a disease – THIS is how we cure it!
summary: On today’s time-sensitive episode of Quick Charge, we revisit the idea that even a broken clock is right twice a day as we examine US President Donald Trump’s takes on electric vehicles, range anxiety, highway road signs, and why he’s absolutely right.

title: Global EV sales rose in July – except in North America
summary: Global EV sales rose 9% in July, but the growth map couldn’t look more uneven.

title: Tesla plans massive new V4 Supercharger in San Francisco
summary:
Tesla wants to build one of its biggest Superchargers yet right in the middle of San Francisco. Planning permits have been filed for a 124-stall V4 station on the city’s south side.

The site is a yellow-cab storage lot at the corner of Alemany and Bayshore, wedged against the US-101 freeway. The permits also call for a 400-square-foot amenity building on the property.

title: US EV prices are going back up as discounts shrink
summary: After six straight months of year-over-year declines, the average transaction price (ATP) paid for a new EV in the US is rising again.

title: As EV sales, oil costs and temperatures spike, UK gov’t considers… fewer EVs?
summary: The UK government is considering relaxing its landmark electric vehicle rules, even in the face of inflated oil prices, a recordbreaking year for temperatures and wildfires, and EV sales that are already rising fast enough to meet the government’s current target.

title: BYD’s new electric sedan is the size of a Tesla Model 3, but half the price
summary: BYD’s new sedan is about the size of a Tesla Model 3, but it’s half the cost in China. The new Seal 06 went on sale in China, starting at just 109,900 yuan, or about $16,500.

title: The strange story behind Colorado’s ‘no catch’ free e-bike company
summary:
It started as one of the most talked-about e-bike deals in the country. Colorado residents could get what was advertised as a “free” electric bike by applying the state’s e-bike tax credit, with Bear Trail Bikes matching the discount. Customers were generally left paying little more than sales tax.

For many riders, it sounded too good to pass up.
